name: White Sand Restaurant (The Fern Residency Jamnagar)
why_it_matters: The Fern Residency Jamnagar (Marriott Series) sits on the city outskirts at Theba Chowkdi — explicitly positioned by the brand as the convenient base for Narara Marine NP + Khijadiya Bird Sanctuary day-trippers. White Sand is the all-day pure-veg restaurant, with an atmospheric rooftop bar 7-11 PM that's the only proper sundowner setting in the Marine NP catchment.
insider_tip: Narara intertidal walks are tide-locked — early morning at low tide. Pre-book a 5 AM packed-breakfast box with the kitchen the night before; standard breakfast service won't help your tide window. Pirotan trips need a full-day food pack — there's no food or water on the island.
signature_address: The Fern Residency Jamnagar, Series by Marriott, Theba Chowkdi, Theba, Jamnagar 361004

name: Hotel Kalpana
area: Pandit Nehru Marg, near Teen Batti, Jamnagar
signature_dish: Closest legacy Gujarati thali to Narara jetty
why_it_matters: Established 1976, in Jamnagar's Teen Batti / Pandit Nehru Marg cluster — the closest legacy Gujarati-Kathiyawadi thali within the Marine NP catchment. 4.2/5 across 2,200+ Justdial reviews; the budget pre-Narara breakfast or post-Pirotan dinner option when you don't want resort-restaurant pricing.
insider_tip: Service runs in two windows only — 10 AM-4 PM and 7-11 PM, so doesn't suit an early-morning Narara return. Combine with morning intertidal walk + late lunch as you head back through Jamnagar town. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: Opposite DSP Bunglow Road, Pandit Nehru Marg, Jawahar Lal Nehru Marg, Kadiawad, Jamnagar 361001
